messages.text:
"Create a fully playable 3D voxel sandbox game titled exactly MemeticBox. This must be an extreme, physics-driven, ultra-gory voxel action sandbox that closely recreates the real MemeticBox experience. Use a hybrid first-person / third-person camera. Everything must feel heavy, messy, and satisfying.
Core Visual Style @COMMENT_BODY@ Voxel System
Pure 3D voxel art style with high voxel density.
Every character is built from thousands of small voxels with full multi-layer anatomy:
Outer clothing layer (fabric that tears, frays, and flies off)
Skin layer
Muscle and fat layer
Bone layer
Internal organs (heart, lungs, liver, intestines, stomach, brain)
Eyes with visible pupils that can be destroyed individually
Clothing must have details: folds, pockets, buttons, zippers, different colors and styles.
Faces must have clear eyes, mouths, noses, and varied hairstyles.
Environment is also fully voxel-based and destructible (trees, ground, vehicles, buildings).
Gore, Dismemberment @COMMENT_BODY@ Gibs System (Highest Priority)
Extreme, layered destruction. Bullets, blades, and explosions must carve through each anatomical layer.
Full dismemberment: heads, arms, legs, and torsos can cleanly separate and become independent physics objects.
Massive gib system: when a body is heavily damaged it explodes into many individual gibs — flesh chunks, muscle pieces, bone fragments, organs, clothing scraps, and blood voxels.
Gibs must fly outward with realistic force and direction based on the weapon and hit location, then bounce, roll, and leave blood trails.
Different weapons produce different gib patterns:
Rifles and pistols create penetrating holes and focused damage
Explosives and shotguns create wide sprays of many gibs
Blades (katana) create clean slices and large separated limbs
Flamethrower creates burnt, crumbling, charred gibs
Blood is volumetric: arterial sprays, red mist, pooling on the ground, staining surfaces and clothing, and lingering for a long time.
Show exposed bone and organs when outer layers are destroyed.
Add the red text popup “CASUALTY REPORT – CIVILIAN KILLED” (or “CIVILIAN KILLED”) whenever a non-hostile NPC dies.
Ragdoll, Stagger @COMMENT_BODY@ Balance
Characters do not instantly ragdoll from every hit.
Light and medium hits cause realistic stagger, flinch, stumble, and temporary loss of balance while they stay on their feet.
Heavy hits, headshots, or repeated damage break their balance and force a full ragdoll.
Ragdolls must feel heavy and realistic with proper joint limits, momentum, tumbling, and bouncing.
When a limb is severed the remaining body reacts with a strong stagger or collapse.
Lightly wounded characters can slowly try to stand back up after a few seconds unless they are bleeding out or too damaged.
Weapons @COMMENT_BODY@ Controls
Bottom weapon bar with clear numbered buttons:
Guard (fists)
Rifle (service rifle)
Deagle
Grenade
Flame (flamethrower)
Kat (katana)
More… (extra weapons: shotgun, sniper, chainsaw, knife, etc.)
Every weapon has unique sounds, muzzle flashes, impact effects, and gore behavior.
Working LASER button: toggles a clear red laser sight beam on the current weapon that shows exactly where you are aiming, with a red dot on surfaces and enemies.
FIRE button, RELOAD button, JUMP button, and on-screen joystick.
Ammo counter and reloading animation with visible magazines.
God Tools Menu
Purple “GOD TOOLS” button that opens a full set of powers:
Grab @COMMENT_BODY@ Throw
Stretch limbs until they tear
Lightning strike
Impale / spike
Hang
Force push/pull
Spawn explosion
Spawn fire
Freeze time / slow motion
Laser Eyes (player or any character can fire burning red laser beams from their eyes that damage and ignite targets)
Photo mode / free camera
Clean / remove all bodies
Spawn civilian, enemy, or vehicle
Maps @COMMENT_BODY@ World
Start in a large open grassy field with dirt paths, trees, a green military jeep, and several walking civilians
"
